Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick demo at KubeCon (timezones)

Hi Marissa \u0014

I'll be at KubeCon next week and would love to lock in a short demo while I'm on-site. We're on a tight schedule the week of Nov 2 \u0014 would Wednesday 11/04 at 10:00 AM (my local time at the hotel) work for you? My calendar shows PST but our London office folks sometimes get invited in BST and get confused.

I'm cc'ing Karen (ops) \u0014 she will join if available.

Attaching a quick agenda. Heads up: my phone sometimes displays the invite in my home timezone (GMT), so can you include the explicit timezone label (America/Los_Angeles) in the invite?

Thanks,
Sam

Senior Cloud Architect, Acme Cloud

Thanks \u0014 Wednesday 11/04 should be fine. Jonas and Mateo are on the thread; Mateo will run the demo. Quick note on the timezone: we'll send a calendar invite explicitly set to America/Los_Angeles (PDT). Since DST ended on Nov 1, the offset is -08:00 now \u0014 I'll include the UTC equivalent to avoid mixups (10:00 PT = 18:00 UTC).

Jonas / Mateo \u0014 can you confirm availability for 11/04 10:00 AM PT and a 30-minute slot? Also attaching the agenda we received from Sam.

\u0014Marissa
